name: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026
short_description: A half marathon with 12 km and 7 km obstacle runs, a 5 km and a kids' obstacle run, held on 27 September 2026 at Summarecon Mall Serpong, Tangerang Selatan, Banten, Indonesia.
ai_summary: The Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 was held on Sunday 27 September 2026 at Summarecon Mall Serpong in Tangerang Selatan, Banten, Indonesia, organised by Menaravisi Events Management. It offered a 21.1 km half marathon (5.15am start, 3 hour 30 minute cut-off), 12 km and 7 km obstacle runs, a 5 km, and a Kids Obstacle Run for ages 4 to 10 on Saturday 26 September. Road races started at Gate 1 of the mall and finished at Uptown Park.

core_facts.venue: Summarecon Mall Serpong (start Gate 1, finish Uptown Park), Tangerang Selatan, Banten

pros: Flat half-marathon course: highest point 38 m, 70 m of climbing
Obstacle runs over 7K and 12K, plus a kids' course
Pacers from sub-100 minutes to a 3:15 sweeper
Eight water stations on the half, with fruit, gel and cooling at 14 km
Entries can be transferred through the organiser
cons: Very humid: 94% humidity and a 24°C dew point at the 2026 start
Start area closes at the gun; late arrivals cannot start
Prize money only for Indonesians and KITAS holders

excerpt_quotes.attribution: Participant Agus Koharudin, quoted in kumparan.com recap of the 2025 edition

excerpt_quotes.quote: Di tantangan terakhir, kita diajak masuk labirin yang berkelok, di atasnya ada hujan buatan, dan sepanjang labirin ada tanaman merambat

research_highlights: The 2026 edition offered a half marathon, 12K and 7K obstacle runs, a 5K and a Kids Obstacle Run (ages 4-10, Saturday 26 September); the road races started at Gate 1 Summarecon Mall Serpong and finished at Uptown Park, whereas in 2025 both start and finish were at Uptown Park.

Official 2026 cut-offs were 3 hours 30 minutes for the half marathon, 3 hours for the 12K obstacle run, 2 hours 15 minutes for the 7K and 1 hour 20 minutes for the 5K, with starts from 05:15 to 06:15 WIB; the 2025 half-marathon cut-off was also 3 hours 30 minutes.
The organiser describes the half-marathon route as World Athletics Certified and aimed at runners chasing a personal best; its map gives 70 m of elevation gain.

The 12K obstacle course had five obstacle zones, including ones named Warrior Jump, Warrior Labyrinth, Warrior Woods and Warrior Crawl; a 2025 runner described the final labyrinth as winding, with artificial rain overhead.
At Soekarno-Hatta airport, about 13 km north, it was 25°C with 94% humidity and haze at 5am on race morning, rising to 28°C by 8am.
research_watchouts: No refunds are given except where legally required, and event dates, times, or locations can be changed by the organizer at any time.
Only Indonesian citizens and foreigners holding a KITAS are eligible for podium placings or prize money; other foreign participants run non-competitively.

As of the sources found, there is little independent participant race-report detail (e.g., on course crowding, water stations, or heat issues) beyond organizer-sponsored recaps and promotional community write-ups.

faqs.question: When is the Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 was held on Sunday 27 September 2026 at Summarecon Mall Serpong in Tangerang Selatan, Banten. The half marathon started at 5.15am, followed by the 12 km obstacle run at 5.35am, the 7 km at 6am and the 5 km at 6.15am. The kids' obstacle run was on Saturday 26 September.

faqs.question: What distance options are available?
faqs.answer: Five categories: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 12 km obstacle run, a 7 km obstacle run, a 5 km road run and a Kids Obstacle Run for children aged 4 to 10. The half marathon was the competitive headline race, with national and master age-group prize money, while the obstacle runs mixed road running with built obstacle zones.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: At Summarecon Mall Serpong in Tangerang Selatan, Banten. In 2026 the road races started at Gate 1 of the mall and finished at Uptown Park, and the half-marathon course looped through the Summarecon Serpong estate past Gading Raya Golf. The kids' obstacle run used an area in Cluster Mozart, meeting at Uptown Park.
